userGoal: Full D0 prediction/rollback with continuous newly presented game states at CPU4, including continuous phone drag and joystick. Smooth slowdown caused by lack of network information is acceptable; large freezes are not.
narrowChange: Remove already-received synchronous touch commands from the asynchronous managed filesystem/resource queue. Keep the existing host envelope and per-event native movement order; consume ineligible controls serials without replaying their actions when eligibility returns.
forbiddenShortcuts: No new direct-input bridge or host protocol command
No document.hasFocus or netplay.active-only input gate
No gesture coalescing or last-point replacement
No native game_tick/draw/pump from input handlers
No reset of mapped serials on pause/game_open/restart
No rewritten host DATA provider or alternate Runtime carrier
No moving or overwriting frozen baseline evidence

receiver: Use the actual managed message/lifecycle listeners with only dependencies controlled; do not write closure state or call command() as the message path
Active direct-touch/controls/cancel native calls and legal ACKs complete while unrelated resources remain unresolved
Retain every direct MOVE, coordinate transform and native call order
Core-not-created, initialization-not-complete, ready-without-launch and launched-with-unresolved-connect states consume input without late native replay
Existing onClose/onGameFrame stop, fatal and pagehide revoke old asynchronous launch completion; no invented stop message
Hidden/blur/overlay/disable/mode change neutralize relevant transient movement and preserve correct action pulse semantics
Same WindowProxy/epoch with a replaced or disconnected document does not permit old receiver input
Source bomb/escape serial changes received while ineligible do not become actions upon repeated post-resume controls
Normal fire/focus/sensitivity controls do not cancel an ongoing direct gesture
Current valid parent touch remains permitted when the child document does not have focus
All source/origin/protocol/game/epoch gates and legal ACK/error behavior remain effective
native: Test actual TouchController.hpp, not a JavaScript model
cancel preserves remaining accepted action pulses; reset clears pulses but retains private serial baselines
Repeated same mapped neutral controls clear axes/focus without refreshing pulses or losing fire preference
New/jumped/nonmonotonic/wrapped serial changes retain one change event per native call; duplicate values do not refresh
Cancelled direct drag cannot revive from an orphan MOVE; a new DOWN works
Free joystick speed/focus selection and existing deathbomb behavior remain valid
integration: Materialize normal/multiplayer directory Runtime from the frozen release WASM and candidate shell with exact source identities
Use an ordinary current React Launcher and its immutable Runtime generation and Package Store ownership for browser or Android acceptance
Record device/browser/origin/forwarding and separate source event, host submission, receiver/native call and sampled frame boundaries
Retain unsuccessful setup or acceptance results under distinct labels; do not relabel VM success as physical input latency or mobile FPS

interpretation: This receiver fix cannot preempt a browser main thread that has not dispatched a message task.
Receiver-local lifetime metadata cannot identify same-epoch host messages that were posted earlier but have not yet entered the receiver.
VM fake clocks establish ordering and gates, not elapsed phone milliseconds or actual native movement.
The unchanged native WASM keeps the preceding deep-correctness evidence relevant to engine identity; this does not replace hosted-input integration.
Continuous moving-target prediction and observed rAF waiting remain independent unresolved work.
